package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	httpmw "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"io"
	"net/http"
)

type LessonCompletionService interface {
	Content(context.Context, string, string) (json.RawMessage, error)
	AcknowledgeTheory(context.Context, string, string, string, string) (domain.LearningPathItem, error)
}

func (h StudentLearningJourneyHandler) GetLessonItemContent(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	student, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok || h.Completion == nil {
		http.Error(w, "unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	v, err := h.Completion.Content(r.Context(), student, chi.URLParam(r, "itemID"))
	if err != nil {
		writeLessonCompletionError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, v)
}
func (h StudentLearningJourneyHandler) AcknowledgeLessonTheory(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	student, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok || h.Completion == nil {
		http.Error(w, "unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var v struct {
		RequirementID string `json:"requirement_id"`
	}
	d := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 4096))
	d.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := d.Decode(&v); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := d.Decode(&struct{}{}); err != io.EOF {
		http.Error(w, "invalid body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	item, err := h.Completion.AcknowledgeTheory(r.Context(), student, chi.URLParam(r, "itemID"), v.RequirementID, r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"))
	if err != nil {
		writeLessonCompletionError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, item)
}

func writeLessonCompletionError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
		http.Error(w, "conflict", http.StatusConflict)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
		http.Error(w, "invalid lesson completion request", http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
		http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
	default:
		writeDomainError(w, err)
	}
}
